parameters.help_en:
The reconstruction mode. Valid values:
MANUAL: manual. This value is used only when you use the annotation tool for reconstruction. This is the default value.
SEMI_AUTOMATIC: semi-automatic. This value is used only for automated modeling on the mobile app
parameters.help_zh:
MANUAL（手动）：仅限使用标注工具重建时使用此参数（默认调用参数）；
SEMI_AUTOMATIC（自动）：仅限基于App端进行自动化建模时使用；
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The wall height. Default value: 0, which indicates that the wall height is not set. Valid values: 200 to 1000. Unit: cm
parameters.help_zh: 墙高，默认0不设置，范围200-1000. 单位cm
parameters.name: wall_height

parameters.help_en:
The wall width optimization mode. Valid values:
OFF: disabled. This is the default value.
NORMAL: standard.
ENHANCED: enhanced
parameters.help_zh: 墙宽优化，OFF：关闭（默认） NORMAL：标准 ENHANCED：加强
parameters.name: optimize_wall_width

parameters.help_en:
The model style. Valid values:
PATCH: patch model. This is the default value.
DEPTH: depth model
parameters.help_zh: 模型效果 PATCH：切片模型（默认） DEPTH：深度模型
parameters.name: model_style

parameters.help_en:
The floor plan style. Valid values:
DEFAULT: default. This is the default value.
STANDARD: standard
parameters.name: plan_style

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The authentication diagnostics details returned when permission verification fails. The details include the authenticated principal, action, policy, and cause of denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 权限校验失败时返回的鉴权诊断详情，包含鉴权主体、操作、策略和拒绝原因

AuthAction.description_en: The authentication action that triggered the permission denied error. You can use this information to troubleshoot the issue or grant the required permissions
AuthAction.description_zh: 触发无权限错误的鉴权操作，可用于排查或授予所需权限

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the authenticated principal. The display format varies for RAM users, RAM roles, and SSO federated identities
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份标识；RAM 用户、RAM 角色和 SSO 联合身份的展示形式不同

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the authenticated principal belongs
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 鉴权主体所属阿里云账号的 UID

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The identity type of the authenticated principal, such as a RAM user, RAM role, or SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份类型，例如 RAM 用户、RAM 角色或 SSO 联合身份

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_en: The encoded diagnostic message for the permission denied error. An account administrator with the required permissions can decode this message to troubleshoot the cause of denial
EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 无权限错误的编码诊断信息，可交由具备权限的账号管理员解码以排查拒绝原因

NoPermissionType.description_en: The type of the cause for the permission denied error, which distinguishes between lack of explicit authorization and explicit denial
NoPermissionType.description_zh: 无权限原因类型，区分未被显式授权和被显式拒绝

PolicyType.description_en: The type of the policy that caused the permission denied error, such as a control policy, session policy, or identity-based policy
PolicyType.description_zh: 导致无权限的策略类型，例如管控策略、会话策略或基于身份的策略

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
